readout_other: Somatosensory evoked potentials (median nerve stimulation) recorded with flexible epidermal electrodes and epidural electrodes
direction_notes: SSEP peak-to-peak amplitude dropped immediately after sonication, proportionally to dose (40% at 1.2 J, 68% at 3 J, 77% at 9 J), with incomplete recovery at higher doses; sham had no effect.
safety_notes: Authors state the RMS pressure per pulse is approximately one half the value reported to elicit histological evidence of mild brain trauma.

exposures.label: Focused ultrasound perturbation of frontal lobe (40, 100 or 300 pulses)

timing.protocol_description: Pulse train of 1.1 MHz sinusoidal pulses, each of duration 10 ms, followed by an off time of 200 ms; 40, 100 or 300 pulses per animal.
